entities.summary: Mark Cross is a hard rock and heavy metal drummer of English/German descent. He has played in many bands in his career and is currently based in London, England. Cross recorded in 1992 an album with Greek singer/songwriter Michalis Rakintzis named "Etsi Maresei" featuring also Deep Purple singer Ian Gillan.
